en.pointSummaryBody: Pick any date range and get a short summary of it (i.e., how much you drank and spent).
en.pointTrendsBody: See how your drinking and spending change over time, and which shops you go to most.
en.pointYearBody: Your whole year laid out on one page, so you can see when (and how often) you drink.
en.scrollRoller: Scroll roller: drag it up to roll the scroll, let go to drop it
en.subheading: More than you'd admit, probably. Log every cup in one tap and see the total (and the damage).

zh.pointSummaryBody: 选任意一段时间，就能看到它的总结（也就是喝了多少杯、花了多少钱）。
zh.pointTrendsBody: 看看你喝的杯数和花费怎样随时间变化，以及你最常去的是哪几家店。
zh.pointYearBody: 一整年的记录都排在同一页上，什么时候喝了、喝了多少，一看就知道。
zh.scrollRoller: 卷轴下轴：向上拖动卷起，松手落下
zh.subheading: 大概比你愿意承认的还多。每杯点一下，就能看到总数（还有钱包的损失）。
